title: PRD: BrainPal Android Application Reconstruction
summary: Reconstruct the BrainPal application from original APK into a clean-room native Android application using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for smart screen time interventions, app usage monitoring, meme roasts, and Material 3 UX.
notes: Matches PRD convention. Contains 8 major functional tasks covering environment setup, APK static analysis, architecture planning, screen reconstruction, wellbeing background logic, unit/integration testing, defect remediation, and final release packaging.
